forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {目覚|めざ}めていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To transition from sleep to a state of wakefulness.

definitions.gloss: to awaken to, to become aware of
definitions.explanation: To realize or become conscious of something, such as a feeling, talent, or truth (figurative use).

examples.english: I woke up at 6 in the morning.
I woke up to the sound of birds.

examples.english: I keep waking up in the middle of the night.

notes:
{目覚|めざ}める is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to wake up or awaken.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye) + ⟦{覚|さ}める→覚める：02058_sameru⟧ (to become aware) → eyes become aware/open

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{目覚|めざ}め→目覚め：13676_mezame⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state of being awake.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{目覚|めざ}める (wake up in the morning)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目覚|めざ}める (awaken to~, become aware of~)
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目覚|めざ}める (awaken to one's talent)
- ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{目覚|めざ}める (awaken to love)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{目覚|めざ}まし→目覚まし：08550_mezamashi⟧: alarm clock (⟦{目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}→目覚まし時計：03159_mezamashidokei⟧)
- ⟦{目覚|めざ}め→目覚め：13676_mezame⟧: awakening (noun)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: to get up (focuses on getting out of bed)
- {目覚|めざ}める focuses on the transition from sleep to wakefulness
